note: Screens 15-D1 … 15-D6 (post-it '15 stage cards → detail comparison'). match rules: 'eq' (player value equals real), 'stationB' (chose option B), 'range' (number inside [min,max] = MATCH, inside [cmin,cmax] = CLOSE), 'atLeast', 'sim' (simulated: no badge).

stages.name: CREW & BUILD

rows.real_value: Cruise stage + aeroshell carrying the lander and rover
Solar panels on the cruise stage
Low-gain + medium-gain X-band antennas
Spin-stabilized: the spacecraft spun at about 2 rpm during cruise

stages.why: A spinning cruise stage stays stable, and its wide-beam antennas can still reach Earth while it spins.

stages.name: INSTRUMENTS

rows.real_value: Athena payload: Pancam, Mini-TES, Microscopic Imager, APXS, Mössbauer, RAT
All science goals covered
Every instrument built for the rover
Simulated game value (no real equivalent)

stages.why: Each instrument answered a different question: color and context, minerals from afar, texture, chemical elements and iron minerals.

stages.name: ORBIT

rows.real_value: Mid 2003 (Spirit in June, Opportunity in July)
Transfer trajectory from Earth to Mars, about 7 months
About 7 months: arrived in January 2004
Simulated game value (no real equivalent)

stages.why: Earth and Mars line up for an efficient trip only about every 26 months. Launching in that window saves a lot of fuel.

stages.name: LAUNCH

rows.real_value: Meteor storms are a game challenge, not a real MER launch event
Six trajectory correction maneuvers (TCMs) were planned during the trip
Delta II rockets from Cape Canaveral, Florida

stages.why: The meteor storm is a game challenge. The real team planned several small engine burns to fine-tune the path during the trip.

stages.name: ROCK HUNTER

rows.real_value: Rocks and soils analyzed in place (no samples returned)
Hematite "blueberries", jarosite, gypsum veins, clays, silica
Solar powered: a planet-wide dust storm in 2018 ended Opportunity's mission

stages.why: The rovers could not bring samples home, so they chose targets carefully and combined clues from several instruments.

stages.name: DATA SENT

rows.real_value: Mostly relayed through orbiters (Odyssey, MGS), plus direct-to-Earth
Short orbiter passes of 2 to 8 minutes each
Rover health and key science first
Simulated game value (no real equivalent)

stages.why: Relaying through orbiters let the rovers send much more data: 89% of the prime-mission data came home that way.
